card.title: No Trouble at All
card.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry your book bag to the platform. My shoulder should manage one more staircase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it. There are dictionaries in there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, keep your hands free for the tickets. I'll change shoulders at the bottom.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've moved our train to platform twelve, across the bridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, lead the way. I'll give each shoulder a staircase and rest my fingers while you find our seats.

mechanism: A courteously keeps carrying a heavy bag while naming each additional bodily cost as the route gets harder.
confusable: Unlike simple martyrdom without help, A must remain actively accommodating throughout the complaints.
comparison: D45-b itemizes physical strain during a station change; D45-a itemizes waiting while others eat.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
